lines: #It's easy to look back and feel like you *wasted* it.
The goals you set in January. The plans that *faded.*
#But there are still thirty one days left.
#You can't fix the whole year in a month.
But you can change how it *ends.*
Save something before the new year *arrives.*
#Because how you finish this year is how you'll *start* the next.
Small wins in December become *momentum* in January.
They'll walk into January *tired* and behind.
#Don't wait for a new year to become a new *you.*
end: Send this to someone who wants to finish the year strong.

post.title: The Year Isn't Over. Finish Strong.
post.caption: How you finish this year is how you'll start the next. 🌅
post.first_comment: What's one thing you'll finish before the year ends? 👇
